Name: `quiet`
Description: Do not show any messages during the boot process.
Notes: This is a part of [linux kernel's parameter](https://docs.kernel.org/admin-guide/kernel-parameters.html).

Name: `androidboot.enable_console`
Notes: Press `Ctrl+Alt+F1` to open the virtual console if enabled, `Ctrl+Alt+F7` to go back to Android GUI.

Name: `DEBUG`
Notes:
Set to `0` to disable. Overrides `quiet` kernel argument.
Set to `1` to launch a shell on rootfs mounted.
Set to `2` to launch a shell on rootfs mounted and another shell after the hook scripts are executed.

On debug shell, type `exit` or press `Ctrl+D` to exit the shell.

Name: `DEBUG_VSOCK`
Notes: Guest CID is hardcoded to `3` and port is hardcoded to `5555`. Guest VM with VSOCK enabled can be connected using `adb connect vsock:3:5555`

Name: `androidboot.insecure_adb`
Notes: **WARNING!!! THIS OPTION SHOULD ONLY BE USED TEMPORARY, NOT TO SET PERMANENTLY AS IT LITERALLY BYPASSES ALL OF ADB SECURITY MEASURES!!!**
